title: containers.conf: add a no_new_privileges option
body:
### Feature request

containers.conf has no key for the `no-new-privileges` security option, so there is no way to make it the default for every container, or for the containers that load a given `--module`.

Today it can only be set per run with `podman run --security-opt no-new-privileges`. A `no_new_privileges = true` setting under `[containers]` that sets `process.noNewPrivileges` in the generated OCI spec would let a containers.conf module bundle it with the other hardening for a tier of untrusted containers, for example:

```toml
[containers]
netns = "none"
no_new_privileges = true

[engine]
runtime = "runsc"
```

### Current behaviour

- `common/pkg/config/config.go` on `main` has no such field in `ContainersConfig`.
- Unknown keys are only logged at debug level, so `no_new_privileges = true` in a module is ignored silently.
- Checked on Podman 5.8.9: with that key in a module, the OCI spec has `process.noNewPrivileges: null` and `prctl(PR_GET_NO_NEW_PRIVS)` returns 0 inside the container. With `--security-opt no-new-privileges` it returns 1.

### Expected behaviour

A `[containers]` boolean, defaulting to `false`, whose effect is the same as passing `--security-opt no-new-privileges` on every `run` and `create`. The command-line flag should still override it.
